import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Constants
ARRAY_SIZE = 10000
def task_func():
    array = np.random.randint(1, 101, size=ARRAY_SIZE)
    mean = np.mean(array)
    std = np.std(array)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.hist(array, bins=range(1, 102), edgecolor='black')

    ax.axvline(mean, color='red', linestyle='--', label='Mean')
    ax.axvline(mean - std, color='purple', linestyle='--', label='Std Dev')
    ax.axvline(mean + std, color='purple', linestyle='--')

    ax.set_title("Histogram of Random Integers")
    ax.set_xlabel("Value")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.legend()

    return array, mean, std, ax
